say:1:1330336001:1.text: Nothing yet... but my gut tells me a fish will bite soon!
say:1:1330336001:1.source_cn: 截止目前还没有……不过我预感马上就会有鱼上钩！
say:1:1330336001:1.male: Nothing yet... but my gut tells me a fish will bite soon!
say:1:1330336001:1.female: Nothing yet... but my gut tells me a fish will bite soon!

say:2:1330336002:1.text: The float moved several times just now, but with all this mist, I couldn't see clearly.
say:2:1330336002:1.source_cn: 其实刚才就有好几次鱼儿咬钩，但这里温泉水汇入，雾气太大...
say:2:1330336002:1.male: The float moved several times just now, but with all this mist, I couldn't see clearly.
say:2:1330336002:1.female: The float moved several times just now, but with all this mist, I couldn't see clearly.

say:3:1330336003:1.text: But it's also because of the warmth that the fish here can grow bigger.
say:3:1330336003:1.source_cn: 但正是因为温泉水温暖水域，这里的鱼才比其他水域都要大。
say:3:1330336003:1.male: But it's also because of the warmth that the fish here can grow bigger.
say:3:1330336003:1.female: But it's also because of the warmth that the fish here can grow bigger.
